# v2.27-dev Release Notes

## New: Offerings

Track a partner's ability to deliver **joint product offerings**. An offering
(for example, "Network Security Modernization") bundles one or more
**specialisations**, and each specialisation lists the supporting trainings a
partner needs to deliver it. Offerings sit alongside Programs with their own
navigation section and dashboards.

### What's new

- **Create offerings** under **Admin → Offerings** — each with a name,
  description, link, and one or more specialisations (the same list as
  Admin → Specialisations). For every specialisation you choose which
  **Certifications, Accreditations, ILTs and OLXs** support it, with
  **alternatives** (any one counts) and a **minimum required** number.
- **Dynamic navigation** — a new **Offerings** section in the sidebar lists
  every configured offering as a child link, refreshing automatically.
- **Onshore / Offshore view** — open an offering, pick a **Country** or
  **Region**, and see, per specialisation:
  - **Onshore** — distinct people holding each training in the selected country
    (or region), with a **Met / Not met** badge against the minimum required.
  - **Offshore** — the rest of that theatre (all other countries in the
    theatre, with the onshore countries removed) — the wider capability
    available to support delivery.
  - Nothing is shown until you select a country or region.
- **Drill-down & export** — click **View** on any count to list the people
  behind it, and use **Export** (CSV / Excel / PDF) for the current view.
- **Import / Export on the admin page** — round-trip your offerings (offering,
  description, link, specialisation, training, minimum, alternatives) as
  CSV / Excel, with a downloadable template and a dry-run validation preview.
- **Public API** — `GET /api/public/v1/offerings` returns offering definitions;
  add `?country=` or `?region=` for Onshore/Offshore compliance figures scoped
  to your API key's companies (`?name=` narrows to one offering).

### Also improved

- **Backups now include Programs and Offerings** — both the **full** backup and
  the **config** backup carry the offering + program reference data, and both
  restore paths rebuild them. (Previously the program reference tables were only
  in config backups.) Older archives without these files still restore exactly
  as before.

### Notes

- Includes a database migration that adds the new offering tables. It runs
  automatically on update.
- Offering compliance figures are scoped to the company selected in the header,
  the same as the Programs dashboards.

No action needed after updating beyond the automatic migration.
